rows.commentary: 0.4: Bernard Scholtz drags his length too full and wide, inviting a square slice from Balbirnie that flies directly to the fielder at point.
0.5: Bernard Scholtz fires this one speared full into off stump, safely met by a firm drive from Balbirnie toward the covers.
0.6: Bernard Scholtz takes pace off outside off, devoured by the cover fielder as Balbirnie punches straight to him to seal a immaculate opening maiden over.
1.1: Smit strays onto the pads with a full delivery, allowing Tim Tector to get off the mark instantly by clipping it away to the deep square-leg boundary.
1.2: Smit responds with a disciplined length angled away, tempting Tim Tector into an expansive drive that only beats thin air.
1.3: Smit brings it back off a length sharply into the batter, catching Tim Tector high on the pads as he misreads the inward seam.
1.4: Smit extracts telling inward movement from a good length on off, expertly covered and blocked down by Tim Tector.
1.5: Smit sends down a probing delivery angling across outside off, easily watched past by Tim Tector as he raises his bat to let it through.
1.6: Smit targets a slightly shorter spot on middle, which Tim Tector stays back to shepherd quietly toward point.
2.1: Bernard Scholtz tosses a flatter trajectory outside off, gently tapped away to point by Balbirnie.
2.2: Bernard Scholtz zips through a quicker, shorter delivery, forcing Balbirnie onto the back foot to successfully blunt the ball.
2.3: Bernard Scholtz shortens his length slightly and angles it inward, met by a crisp punch into the covers from Balbirnie.
2.4: Bernard Scholtz floats it up outside off, and Balbirnie drops to one knee, launching a monstrous slog sweep that clears the rope entirely and demands a replacement ball from the fourth umpire.
2.5: Bernard Scholtz fires it full into the surface, and Balbirnie presses forward decisively to dead-bat the delivery.
2.6: Bernard Scholtz pushes this full delivery on off stump, allowing Balbirnie to stroke it comfortably down towards long-off for a single.
3.1: Smit targets the back of a length close to off, cutting back sharply to beat Balbirnie completely as he hangs on the back foot.
3.2: Smit angles a shorter delivery across the batter, prompting Balbirnie to tap it toward short cover and scamper through for a sharp single.
3.3: Smit drifts a fuller ball onto the pads, catching Tim Tector with a closed face as a leading edge loops agonizingly toward mid-off.
3.4: Smit lands a length delivery outside off that angles away, and Tim Tector wisely withdraws his bat to let it pass through.
3.5: Smit slides it down the leg side, grazing Tim Tector's hip, and they scamper through for a leg bye down to fine leg.
13.5: Ruben Trumpelmann sends one rearing off a length past Harry Tector, drawing a chorus of confident appeals that the umpire shrugs off entirely.
13.6: Ruben Trumpelmann slants this length delivery across the batter, leaving Harry Tector to scramble a hurried bat down on it.
14.1: Jack Brassell oversteps his mark on a sharp, angled back-of-a-length delivery that Tim Tector wildly misses across the line, gifting a free hit.
14.1: Jack Brassell pushes this back-of-a-length delivery into the body, prompting Tim Tector into a fierce, empty swipe.
14.2: Jack Brassell gets a late inward tail that clips Tim Tector's inside edge toward the keeper, allowing a scampered single.
14.3: Jack Brassell bangs this short and rising delivery outside off, leaving Harry Tector to withdraw his bat with absolute ease.
14.4: Jack Brassell pitches full in the hitting arc, allowing Harry Tector to punch a firm drive straight to the cover fielder.
14.5: Jack Brassell targets a shorter length closer to the off-stump, permitting Harry Tector to track it safely through to the keeper.
14.6: Jack Brassell digs another short one outside the channel, with Harry Tector happily lifting his bat to watch it sail by.
15.1: Ruben Trumpelmann serves a back-of-a-length delivery on middle, clipped neatly into the backward square leg gap by Tim Tector as Ireland brings up their fifty.
15.2: Ruben Trumpelmann delivers back of a length, and Tim Tector aggressively steps down the pitch to thrash it toward sweeper cover.
15.3: Ruben Trumpelmann raps Tim Tector on the pads with a sharp inswinger from a length, though another loud appeal is instantly denied.
15.4: Ruben Trumpelmann angles it back sharply, catching the edge of Tim Tector's bat straight onto the pads.
15.5: Ruben Trumpelmann hammers away at that hard length, where Tim Tector dabs to cover before being rightly refused the single.
15.6: Ruben Trumpelmann drops it slightly shorter on middle, allowing Tim Tector to work it smoothly toward backward square leg.
16.1: Jack Brassell tests the back of a length outside off, yielding a couple of runs after a sharp misfield in the ring.
16.2: Jack Brassell pitches fuller and angles it in, met securely by the defensive bat of Tim Tector into the off-side.
16.3: Jack Brassell serves up a fuller delivery that Tim Tector drives past the sprawling mid-off fielder with supreme timing for four.
16.4: Jack Brassell hits a length that Tim Tector stabs directly toward point, unable to sneak through for a run.
16.5: Harry Tector takes 2 off Brassell.
16.6: Jack Brassell delivers a standard length ball, gently patted down to deep cover by Tim Tector for a single.
28.4: Loftie-Eaton loops this delivery up, allowing Harry Tector to push-drive it down to long-off for a routine single.
28.5: Loftie-Eaton fires it on the sticks as Lorcan Tucker drops to one knee for the scoop, missing entirely as the ball races past everyone for four byes.
28.6: Loftie-Eaton delivers again, with Lorcan Tucker working it neatly into the on-side to rotate the strike for a single.
29.1: Ruben Trumpelmann angles down leg onto the pads, past Lorcan Tucker's attempted tuck and straight through to the keeper.
29.2: Ruben Trumpelmann watches Lorcan Tucker drop it softly into the off-side and scamper through as the shy at the stumps misses.
29.3: Ruben Trumpelmann bowls to Harry Tector, who charges the crease and slices the ball down to third man for a single.
29.4: Ruben Trumpelmann tests Lorcan Tucker, who steps into the drive on the up only to pick out the fielder stationed at cover.
29.5: Ruben Trumpelmann extracts an outside edge from Lorcan Tucker's back-of-a-length chase, flying just over the leaping slip fielder for four.
29.6: Ruben Trumpelmann serves up a fuller length wide outside off, which Lorcan Tucker drills hard and on the up past mid-off to the boundary.
30.1: Loftie-Eaton gets turned away as Harry Tector works the ball into the on-side to claim a single.
30.2: Loftie-Eaton drops it up outside off, and Lorcan Tucker gets beneath the flight, launching a flat thump over mid-on to collect four.
30.3: Loftie-Eaton tosses another up, and Lorcan Tucker steers it down into the off-side to rotate the strike with a single.
30.4: Loftie-Eaton fires a flatter trajectory, and Harry Tector chops it directly down to the fielder stationed at point.
30.5: Loftie-Eaton gets it in, and Harry Tector stabs the ball firmly into the off-side straight to cover.
30.6: Loftie-Eaton floats this one up, and Harry Tector plays it solidly right back into the hands of the bowler.
31.1: Jack Brassell pitches it up on a length outside off, drawing an inside edge off Lorcan Tucker's defensive prod for a single.
31.2: Jack Brassell angles a short delivery in, and Harry Tector pulls it down towards fine leg to pick up one.
31.3: Jack Brassell tests the line, but Lorcan Tucker gets squarely behind it to dead-bat a defense down into the off-side.
31.4: Jack Brassell delivers an angled length ball, and Lorcan Tucker gently nudges it towards the fielder waiting at mid-on.
43.5: Gerhard Erasmus drops it in as Curtis Campher shuffles across for an ambitious scoop, mistiming it toward deep square leg before scrambling back frantically for a hurried second run.
43.6: Gerhard Erasmus fires one in halfway down the track, and Curtis Campher dances out of his crease to force a mishit cut into the off-side for a single.
44.1: Ruben Trumpelmann attacks outside off with a full delivery, and Curtis Campher swings violently across the line, securing a thick inside edge that races away wide of short fine leg.
44.2: Ruben Trumpelmann huffs in exasperation as George Dockrell slices a catchable offering out to deep backward point that goes straight through the fielder's hands for two.
44.3: Ruben Trumpelmann serves it full and outside off, inviting George Dockrell to open the bat face and slash a much-needed boundary for Ireland past the deep fielder.
44.4: Ruben Trumpelmann strays with a full toss well outside off, which George Dockrell toe-ends down to third man on the bounce for a single.
44.5: Ruben Trumpelmann sails one past the tramline on the off-side, leaving Curtis Campher aborting his attempted reverse sweep at the very last moment.
44.6: Ruben Trumpelmann offers a delivery that Curtis Campher drills firmly down the ground toward long-off to collect a brisk single.

45.1: Jack Brassell sends down a high full toss that Curtis Campher misses entirely while looking to scoop from deep across his stumps, immediately appealing to the umpire who waves away the no-ball query.
45.2: Jack Brassell induces another attempted scoop from Curtis Campher that loops into the on-side air, narrowly eluding a sensational full-length diving effort from the tumbling wicketkeeper.
45.3: Jack Brassell delivers a tight line that George Dockrell simply nudges out toward the off-side.
45.4: Jack Brassell hits a good length on middle and leg, allowing George Dockrell to clear room and force a magnificent drive through the covers that splits the gap for a boundary.
45.5: Jack Brassell digs this length delivery sharply into the ribs, inviting George Dockrell to pivot and whip it away through deep mid-wicket for a sharp triple.
45.6: Jack Brassell drops in a slower ball outside off, and Curtis Campher clears his front leg, launching it off the toe into the sky just far enough to clear the rope for six.
46.1: Smit serves up a full delivery across the right-hander, prompting George Dockrell to stretch out and squeeze a thick inside edge away toward wide long-on for a single.
46.2: Smit fires a short one well outside off, allowing Curtis Campher to shuffle across and hammer a pull shot behind square on the on-side for his sixth maximum of the innings.
46.3: No run for Curtis Campher off Smit.
46.4: Dot ball from Smit to Curtis Campher.
0.1: Jai Moondra starts things off cleanly to Louren Steenkamp, finding a dot ball right out of the gate.
0.2: Jai Moondra drops it in to Louren Steenkamp, who gets right behind the line and safely defends.
0.3: Jai Moondra angles a length delivery across as Louren Steenkamp stabs it down into the off-side.
0.4: Jai Moondra gets the ball to nip away sharply, leaving Louren Steenkamp beaten on the defensive prod.
0.5: Jai Moondra shapes one across the batter, allowing Louren Steenkamp to steer it down to third man for a single.
0.6: Jai Moondra bangs it back of a length outside off, and Malan Kruger hangs back to defend it down toward point.
1.1: Jordan Neill targets the channel outside off on a length, inviting Louren Steenkamp to leave it alone for the keeper.
1.2: Jordan Neill drops back of a length outside off, and Louren Steenkamp reads the line to let it pass.
1.3: Jordan Neill delivers back of a length outside off, patted softly down into the off-side by Louren Steenkamp.
1.4: Jordan Neill attacks from a back of a length, resulting in a crisp punch into the off-side by Louren Steenkamp.
1.5: Jordan Neill tests the bat again, but Louren Steenkamp gets squarely behind the line to block.
1.6: Jordan Neill extracts extra bounce outside off as Louren Steenkamp rides it down to point, watching the ball nibble away.
2.1: Jai Moondra digs it in hard on a length, angling across as Malan Kruger watches it sail through to the keeper.
2.2: Jai Moondra strikes down the leg side as Malan Kruger feathers a faint tickle through to Lorcan Tucker to walk back distraught for a duck.
2.3: Jai Moondra spears one short of a length into Jan Frylinck, who hops back to dead-bat it down into the off-side.
2.4: Jai Moondra darts a sharp in-ducker straight at the stumps, forcing Jan Frylinck to drop in behind the line and block back to the bowler.
2.5: Jai Moondra drops a length delivery on the surface, neatly tapped down into the off-side by Jan Frylinck.
2.6: Jai Moondra completes a probing maiden over as Jan Frylinck brings the bat down to smother a fuller delivery right back to the bowler.
12.5: Curtis Campher floats a short of a length delivery outside off, and Gerhard Erasmus fishes loosely outside his line to get completely beaten.
12.6: Curtis Campher runs in to Gerhard Erasmus, who stays deep in his crease and dead-bats the ball firmly into the off-side.
13.1: Liam McCarthy drops it short and angles it across to Loftie-Eaton, who pulls it fiercely away from mid-on to collect a single.
13.2: Liam McCarthy serves up a fuller length outside off, and Gerhard Erasmus simply pats it down into the off-side.
13.3: Liam McCarthy slips a sharp nippy length delivery down leg, grazing the pads on its uninterrupted journey to the keeper.
13.4: Liam McCarthy digs it in far too short, forcing Gerhard Erasmus to duck underneath the pull and watch it sail safely wide.
13.4: Liam McCarthy delivers back of a length outside off, allowing Gerhard Erasmus to stay back and punch it wide of point before third man cleans it up.
13.5: Liam McCarthy pitches on a length and angles it across, leaving Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton searching for a defensive prod and beaten all ends up.
13.6: Liam McCarthy bangs in a short ball, and Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton masters the bounce to pull it down to deep square for a comfortable single.
14.1: Curtis Campher feeds a fuller length angled across, and Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton strides out to drive it uppishly past a helpless cover fielder for four.
14.2: Curtis Campher fires one in at Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton, who gets squarely behind the line and safely blocks it away.
14.3: Curtis Campher delivers back of a length outside off, and Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton steers it down to third man for a quick single.
14.4: Curtis Campher tucks a length ball into the channel, forcing Gerhard Erasmus to block firmly.
14.5: Gerhard Erasmus stands flat-footed outside off, patting the length delivery straight to point.
14.6: Curtis Campher angles it in, missing the bat as it clips the pad for a scampered leg bye.
15.1: Liam McCarthy traps Gerhard Erasmus lbw with a sharply angled length ball, cutting short a stubborn ten-ball stay.
15.2: Liam McCarthy digs it in short and angles it across, allowing Zane Green to watch it sail through to the keeper.
15.3: Liam McCarthy drifts a fuller delivery wide of off, ignored completely by Zane Green as it settles in the gloves.
26.4: Matthew Humphreys darts a flatter, quicker ball onto the pads, and Ruben Trumpelmann gets enough bat on it for the ball to race away to the fine leg boundary.
26.5: Matthew Humphreys floats a full one outside off, inviting Ruben Trumpelmann to launch it powerfully over long-off to clatter into the iron sheets beyond the ropes.
26.6: Matthew Humphreys takes pace off the ball, drawing Ruben Trumpelmann forward to smother it solidly back onto the pitch.
27.1: Liam McCarthy delivers from back of a length angling across, gently guided by Zane Green down towards third man for a single.
27.2: Liam McCarthy tails a full ball into the pads to ignite a loud appeal against Ruben Trumpelmann, though it sails harmlessly down leg.
27.3: Liam McCarthy targets the stumps with a sharp bouncer, tempting Ruben Trumpelmann into a hook shot that flashes past thin air.
27.4: Liam McCarthy offers a fraction of width outside off, punched firmly by Ruben Trumpelmann directly to mid-off.
27.5: Liam McCarthy tests Ruben Trumpelmann with another hostile short ball, catching the batsman flush on the grill as he misses the hook.
27.6: Liam McCarthy pitches it full and angles it into the pads, allowing Ruben Trumpelmann to tuck it neatly away toward backward square leg for a single.
28.1: Matthew Humphreys fires it in flatter and quicker, prompting Ruben Trumpelmann to punch the ball firmly towards mid-on.
28.2: Matthew Humphreys tosses this one up nicely outside off, and Ruben Trumpelmann gets low to drag it away into the mid-wicket region for a single.
28.3: Matthew Humphreys serves up a full delivery that turns inward, which Zane Green calmly guides in the direction of point to pick up a single.
28.4: Matthew Humphreys provides plenty of flight outside off, and Ruben Trumpelmann reads it instantly to launch a towering six high over long-on and deep into the grass banks.
28.5: Matthew Humphreys darts through the arm ball, forcing Ruben Trumpelmann to stay back in his crease and push it straight back to the bowler.
28.6: Matthew Humphreys drops it a touch shorter outside off, and Ruben Trumpelmann guides a sharp cut straight to short third.
29.1: Liam McCarthy delivers from back of a length and angles it across, leaving Zane Green to softly dab it down toward third man for a comfortable single.
29.2: Liam McCarthy targets a short length outside off, prompting Ruben Trumpelmann to swivel quickly and pull it with power to deep square leg.
29.3: Liam McCarthy goes short from round the wicket, but Zane Green reacts with blistering speed to hammer a pull shot through the gap in front of square for four.
29.4: Liam McCarthy persists with the short-pitch tactic, and Zane Green manages to swivel and pull the delivery away toward fine leg for a single.
29.5: Liam McCarthy strays short and down the leg side, where Ruben Trumpelmann eagerly waits to dispatch the pull shot all the way over the ropes at fine leg for a maximum.
38.2: Jai Moondra drops it back of a length outside off, and Jack Brassell creates room before punching it straight to cover-point.
38.3: Jai Moondra targets the channel outside off with a short-of-length delivery, and Jack Brassell watches it sail past.
38.4: Jai Moondra unleashes another yorker, and Jack Brassell angles his bat face to dig it out toward the third man region for a single.
38.5: Jai Moondra angles one into the body of Bernard Scholtz, who tucks it toward deep square leg to rotate the strike.
38.6: Jai Moondra targets the full length and slides one down leg, catching Jack Brassell plumb on the front pad as the umpire instantly raises his finger.
39.1: Matthew Humphreys fires one that grips and spins away, beating Bernard Scholtz entirely as he plays for the defensive line.
39.2: Matthew Humphreys darts a quicker delivery onto off-stump, allowing Bernard Scholtz to drop back and punch it right back to the bowler.
39.3: Bernard Scholtz attempts an on-side whip, but an inside edge cannons into his pads and trickles safely back to Matthew Humphreys.
39.4: Matthew Humphreys tosses it up around off-stump, and Bernard Scholtz safely dead-bats the ball toward the covers.
39.5: Matthew Humphreys gives this one plenty of flight on off-stump, drawing Bernard Scholtz down the pitch to deaden the ball's momentum.
39.6: Bernard Scholtz hammers a full delivery hard down the ground past the bowler, leaving long-off helpless as it races away for four.
40.1: Jai Moondra offers width on a good length, and Jack Brassell opens the bat face to carve it through deep point for a boundary.
40.2: Jai Moondra drops it on a good length outside off, and Jack Brassell dead-bats it straight into the off-side.
40.3: Jai Moondra slides a full one across the right-hander, leaving Jack Brassell swinging into empty air.
40.4: Jai Moondra serves it full on middle and leg, neatly tucked away into the on-side.
40.5: Jai Moondra pitches it full outside off, and Jack Brassell violently slashes it through the off-side gap to scamper back for a brace.
40.6: Jai Moondra wraps up the match with a six-wicket haul as Jack Brassell lobs an awkward back-foot defense straight to George Dockrell at mid-wicket, sealing a 130-run victory for Ireland.

batsmen.name: Louren Steenkamp
batsmen.dismissal: c Curtis Campher b Jai Moondra

batsmen.name: Malan Kruger
batsmen.dismissal: c Lorcan Tucker b Jai Moondra

batsmen.name: Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton
batsmen.dismissal: c Lorcan Tucker b Jordan Neill

batsmen.name: JJ Smit
batsmen.dismissal: c Lorcan Tucker b Matthew Humphreys

batsmen.name: Jack Brassell
batsmen.dismissal: c George Dockrell b Jai Moondra

summary.text: Ireland won by 130 runs. IRE made 298-8, Tim Tector top-scoring with 73 off 81 balls; JJ Smit took 4 for 34. NAM made 168-10, Zane Green (wk) top-scoring with 45 off 58 balls; Jai Moondra took 6 for 26.
